name: coincident-sphere-union-oblique
why: coincident-sphere-union at 37 degrees, where the internal seam wire made the mesher produce an open fragment (4 edges bordering one triangle) instead of a closed one, refused by the watertight backstop rather than the volume one. Same cause, same fix; recorded because the two backstops caught it differently and a fix for one angle is not evidence for the other. Exact B-rep 4188.79 mm³; the mesh matches plain sphere(10).
